question: Pradhan Mantri Virasat Ka Samvardhan (PM VIKAS) Scheme is a scheme of which Ministry of the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is__ the Ministry of Minority Affairs__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The Pradhan Mantri Virasat Ka Samvardhan (PM VIKAS) Scheme is a skilling initiative by the Ministry of Minority Affairs (MoMA) of the Government of India.
